disable.description: delete the cached certificate for a domain

generate.description: generate an SSL/TLS private key and certificate for a domain

skipCertutilInstall.name: skipCertutilInstall
skipCertutilInstall.description: don't attempt to install nss / certutil tooling (needed on some platforms to automate setup)

skipHostsFile.name: skipHostsFile
skipHostsFile.description: don't attempt to modify the /etc/hosts file to support custom domains

list.description: list the domains that devcert has generated a certificate for
examples:
$ devcert list
Configured domains:

my-app.test
client-project.test
